text:
maria: Heads up, release v2.14.0 flagged by SBOM scan — transitive component aes-lib shows unresolved license metadata. deploy-bot quarantined canary.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] canary job 2026-03-21T12:05 failed SBOM provenance check for artifact sha256:abc123def... quarantined.

sanjay: Can we pin to previous digest and continue EU canary? We have change window til 16:00.

kevin: Pinning will still require approval from legal if license unknown. @legal-team please advise :eyes:

legal-team: Quick read — license looks permissive but provenance missing; we can approve a temp pin if we add an audit note and a follow-up ticket to fix provenance. Add a release notes entry explaining the exception.

maria: Proposal: pin artifact for regional canaries in EU/US, do staggered rollout, create an internal ticket for provenance fix. Rollback criteria = immediate rollback if >0.5% error rate or 3+ customer reports in 30m.

sanjay: ops command to pin:
```
deployctl promote --artifact sha256:abc123def --env canary --regions eu,us --pin-reason "SBOM temp pin"
```

kevin: I'll shorten canary window to 30m and add a monitoring alert. prepping the release-notes blurb now.

maria: ok rolling. I'll add audit note and tag the ticket to "security:sbom-provenance".

deploy-bot: Promote started at 12:12 UTC. Canaries in eu/us. Will report health checks every 5m.

deploy-bot: Health checks OK (12:17 UTC). No errors >0.1%.

sanjay: :thumbsup: 

kevin: release-notes draft sent to #release-notes for signoff.

maria: closing this thread — we'll escalate if alerts trigger.
